# Project identity vectors

`vectors.json` freezes exact inputs, complete NHT bytes, and SHA-256 outputs for
captured, complete logical, derivation, and project/view/alternate-format artifact
identities. It belongs to the [identity contract](../../contracts/PROJECT-IDENTITY.md).
Runtime tests own an identical execution copy so this plan can be archived.
